unresolved_bindings: budget and execution duration with explicit expiry at acceptance
compatible deployed personas and current model policy
repository check names, trusted app IDs, harness digest and evidence specification
target connection/account/region, deployed revision and resource/spending authority for separate live run
assistant suite registration/fixtures and actual supported workflow inputs
no_inheritance: Do not reuse the earlier flow budget, authority window or target approval.
activation_rule: Do not register or accept proposal.authored.json alone. Render an explicit supported execution policy and code-evaluation specification, then preview the complete graph. No absent-policy legacy execution.
merge_boundary: Code-only engine policy does not suppress push-triggered deployment. Audit/guard touched workflows or obtain explicit target-scoped rollout authority before affected merges. Initial design and plan approval does not grant that authority.
live_rule: Readiness gate records authorization and evidence; a gate does not itself deploy, dispatch a workflow or widen policy. An authorized operator invokes the existing workflow. Human evaluation accepts evidence through supported UI/API.
budget_note: Owner requested $1000; saved in inert draft version 2. This does not accept the plan or start execution.
